build_ensemble_network: build an ensemble of feed-forward networks using make_ensemble with a base network and num_networks
init_ensemble_params: initialize parameters for multiple ensemble networks using ensemble_init with a base init function and PRNG key
apply_round_robin_inference: apply a base network to batch inputs in round-robin fashion across ensemble members using apply_round_robin
apply_all_ensemble_members: pass inputs through all ensemble members and collect outputs from each using apply_all
compute_ensemble_mean: compute the mean output across all ensemble members for each batch element using apply_mean
